title: Intake of the Stage 2 dataset index supplied 2026-09-09, classified by whether it is raw, summary, already used or reserved
status: staged and classified; nothing is promoted to raw/ or derived/, nothing is fitted, and every reserved observation is unread

inspection_rule.rule: Structure may be read; values may not. File names, formats, sizes, checksums, variable names, array shapes, column headers and row counts are metadata and were read. No numeric value of any reserved observable was read, printed or summarised.
inspection_rule.why: A holdout is spent the moment its observations are looked at. Classifying a file as raw or summary needs its schema, not its contents, so the classification below costs nothing.
inspection_rule.what_this_does_not_protect_against: Reading a variable name can still be informative: knowing that Rozenfeld records paired-pulse ratios at five intervals tells the reader that recovery kinetics were measured, which is already in the paper. The rule protects the values, which is what a holdout is.

raw_per_observation_arrays.what_it_is: paired-pulse ratio per fly at five interstimulus intervals from 10 ms to 1000 ms
raw_per_observation_arrays.why_it_matters: This is a direct measurement of synaptic recovery kinetics across three orders of magnitude of interval, per animal. ND-06 registers a recovery time constant of 893 ms with range 629 to 1006 ms, fitted to Nagel, Hong and Wilson 2015, and its one external test at 7 Hz failed. Five intervals from an independent laboratory is the strongest available test of that parameter.

raw_per_observation_arrays.variables: all_flies_1Hz/10Hz/20Hz/60Hz_control, shapes (18, 32) to (18, 112); matching _RNAi; plus mean_rise_time_* and std_rise_time_*
raw_per_observation_arrays.what_it_is: per-fly response amplitude across a stimulus train at four frequencies, 18 flies per condition
raw_per_observation_arrays.why_it_matters: Depression across a train at 1, 10, 20 and 60 Hz is exactly the observable the registered depression rule predicts, and the four frequencies constrain utilisation and recovery jointly rather than singly.
raw_per_observation_arrays.classification: raw per-animal observations; the mean_rise_time and std_rise_time arrays are derived summaries of the same recordings

raw_per_observation_arrays.what_it_is: 22 recordings of 70001 samples each, in current clamp and in voltage clamp
raw_per_observation_arrays.why_it_matters: Voltage-clamp traces are the form the uEPSC kernel was fitted in. These are candidate held-out waveforms from a preparation that did not contribute to the fit.

raw_per_observation_arrays.what_it_is: miniature EPSC amplitude and frequency per animal, and Bruchpilot puncta counts, intensities and sizes per animal
raw_per_observation_arrays.why_it_matters: Quantal size and release-site number measured in the same preparation. This is the second independent handle on the contact-to-release-site identification that two results this session put under pressure.

derived_summaries_not_reserved: Figure 1/Fig1E.mat and Figure 2/Fig2C.mat, Fig2F.mat, Figure 4/Fig4D.mat, Fig4G.mat: *_knee arrays, which are fitted knee points rather than observations
reserved_as_validation_genuinely_unseen.restriction_that_must_be_honoured: Only the _control arrays are wild-type comparable. The _RNAi arrays are a cacophony calcium-channel knockdown, which changes release probability by design, so they are a manipulation and not a target for a wild-type model.
reserved_as_validation_genuinely_unseen.reservation: Reserved. No value in any file above has been read. Scoring requires a preregistered contract naming the file, the variable, the metric and the limit before the values are opened.
reserved_as_validation_genuinely_unseen.license: check before redistribution; the repository ships analysis code and figure source data without an explicit LICENSE file, so it must not be copied into a GPL release until that is resolved
reserved_as_validation_genuinely_unseen.correction_to_this_entry: This entry, and the what_this_intake_changes list below, said the synaptic leg 'may be reinstatable' because ADR-2026-011 'retired the synaptic leg for want of exactly this' and paraphrased its reinstatement condition as 'raw traces from a preparation not used to fit the kernel'. The paraphrase dropped a word that carries the condition. The gate requires raw *unitary* EPSC traces, and these recordings are not unitary: the authors' own plotting code labels the Figure 3 arrays eEPSC, an evoked compound response to stimulation of the ORN axon bundle, and the Figure 1 traces are odour-evoked whole-cell recordings. The miniature EPSCs in Figure 5 are quantal events, not unitary connection responses. So the reinstatement condition is NOT met, the synaptic leg stays retired, and the Stage 2 exit gate stays at v4 and 0 of 3. What this dataset does test is the observable the retired leg's own caveats named as untested, which is ND-06 short-term plasticity; that test is preregistered separately as stage2-depression-external-test-v1. See ADR-2026-012.
reserved_as_validation_genuinely_unseen.correction_to_the_correction: The correction above got a fact wrong in turn, and the paper's methods settle it: 'eEPSCs were evoked by stimulating ORN axons with a minimal stimulation protocol via a suction electrode.' Minimal stimulation isolates a single-fibre response, so these are unitary and not compound. The synaptic leg still stays retired and the gate still stays 0 of 3, for a different and sharper reason: the repository ships per-animal scalars and per-animal averaged amplitudes, not the unitary WAVEFORMS a kinetics holdout needs. Figure 3 holds paired-pulse ratios and 32-pulse amplitude series; the only raw traces in the repository, Figure 1's IAA_IC and IAA_VC, are odour-evoked whole-cell recordings. If the authors' minimal-stimulation waveforms became available the recorded reinstatement condition would be met. See ADR-2026-012's second amendment.
reserved_as_validation_genuinely_unseen.executed: The five wild-type paired-pulse arrays of Figure 3D are now open and scored under stage2-depression-external-test-v1. Every other file in this entry is still sealed.

An ipsilateral-versus-contralateral manipulation, which bears on the 1.56-fold contact asymmetry this session measured in the bilateral test.

reserved_as_validation_genuinely_unseen.corrects_an_earlier_finding: The stage-3 design contract, registered earlier today, states that DoOR contains no projection-neuron recordings and concludes there is no downloadable per-PN response target. The first half stands and the conclusion does not: Takagi 2024 supplies matched OSN and PN responses in four glomeruli with pharmacological controls. The contract must be revised rather than left standing.
caveats_that_must_be_resolved_before_use: The observable is calcium fluorescence, not firing rate, so scoring needs an observation model and that model is an assumption.

The paper compares Drosophila melanogaster and D. sechellia and the calcium-imaging filenames do not carry the species. Which files are melanogaster must be established from the readme and the analysis code before any of it is used against a melanogaster connectome.
The two wind-tunnel CSVs are 153 MB and 322 MB and are behavioural trajectories, not physiology; they are staged but out of scope.

reserved_as_validation_genuinely_unseen.seal: SEALED. No contract names any of it, so no value in it may be opened. The seal lifts only when a circuit-level prediction contract is committed that states the circuit prediction, the observation model from calcium fluorescence to the quantity the simulator produces, the species assignment of every calcium-imaging file, and the acceptance limit. The stage-3 activity-prediction design is not that contract: it is a design whose data-availability finding these files falsify, and it must be reissued.

The cross-matching table's header carries in_fafb, in_hemibrain, in_banc and in_l1 with no MaleCNS column, which is what raised the question. The join does not go through that table: gt_sources/male_cns/202509-male_cns_gt_data.csv carries a cell_type_mcns column across 3,523 rows, and gt_sources/male_cns/malecns_extra.csv adds 46 more in the older known_nt layout. reserved_as_validation_genuinely_unseen.correction_to_this_entry: This entry said the dataset makes 'ND-03 sign assignment' testable and that the sign 'determines whether each of 25.6 million edges excites or inhibits'. That overstates what a transmitter table can validate. Verified transmitter identity pins the presynaptic term only. An edge's sign is a function of that transmitter AND the postsynaptic receptor, and receptor identity is partner- and dendritic-domain-specific, so a correct transmitter label still leaves the sign unresolved wherever the receptor is unknown. ADR-2026-012 therefore split the old bundled ND-03 into ND-03, presynaptic transmitter identity, which this dataset validates, and ND-10, postsynaptic receptor identity and functional edge polarity, which it cannot. An agreement rate on transmitter identity is an upper bound on sign correctness, not a measurement of it.

reserved_as_validation_genuinely_unseen.priority: high for the contact-to-release-site question, and only partly obtained
reserved_as_validation_genuinely_unseen.paper: Connectomic features underlying diverse synaptic connection strengths and subcellular computation, PMC8825683
reserved_as_validation_genuinely_unseen.correction_to_the_supplied_index: The index describes this as physiology plus morphology plus synapse-location data and highlights Data S2 for mean EPSP waveforms. That is right, but the recordings are from **lateral horn neurons** while stimulating projection neurons, so the synapse measured is PN-to-LHN and not the ORN-to-PN synapse this project parameterises. Its value is as a test of whether contact count predicts physiological strength at all, not as a holdout for the registered uEPSC kernel.
reserved_as_validation_genuinely_unseen.the_finding_that_makes_it_relevant: The paper reports that synapse *density*, meaning count normalised by postsynaptic membrane surface area, predicts mean uEPSP amplitude at r squared 0.77. Two results this session put the identification of one contact with one release site under quantitative pressure, at 2.06 times the published release-site count and a 1.56-fold contact asymmetry where no amplitude asymmetry was measured. A paper that measured both count and amplitude in one preparation is the natural arbiter, and it says the normalisation by membrane area is what carries the prediction.

what_this_intake_changes: The synaptic leg is NOT reinstated, contrary to what this file first said. Its recorded condition requires raw unitary EPSC traces and Rozenfeld's recordings are compound evoked responses. The Stage 2 exit gate stays at v4 and 0 of 3 and is left unedited. See the correction on the Rozenfeld entry and ADR-2026-012.

The registered ND-06 depression rule gains its second external test, preregistered as stage2-depression-external-test-v1 with predictions committed before any value is opened. Rozenfeld supplies per-animal paired-pulse ratios at five intervals and per-animal train responses at four frequencies from a laboratory that contributed nothing to the registered parameters, and the registry has carried an open 100 ms prediction since commit fb01944, which makes that prediction blind by commit ordering.
The cellular leg is not reinstated by anything here. Takagi 2024 is calcium imaging, not current clamp, so it cannot supply resting voltage, membrane time constant or adaptation in physical units.
The stage-3 activity-prediction design must be revised. Its data-availability finding that no per-PN response target is downloadable is now false. Until it is reissued the Takagi files stay sealed.

ND-03 becomes testable for the first time, as presynaptic transmitter identity and not as edge sign. ADR-2026-012 splits the old bundled record into ND-03 and ND-10 for exactly this reason; see the correction on the transmitter entry.
Nothing above changes any verdict. No tier moves, the Stage 2 gate stays 0 of 3, and no fit has been touched.

superseded_in_part_by.what_moves: This file classified the staged datasets in prose. The reservation contract names every reserved file and every reserved variable or column, and the manifest built from it pins each one by checksum and records its structure. Where the two disagree, the contract and the manifest are authoritative.
superseded_in_part_by.corrections_below: Three claims made here were wrong and are corrected in place rather than deleted, in the fields they appear in.
